name: CleaningValidationMatrix
tagline: GMP cleaning validation of shared equipment – matrix, MACO limits, worst cases and runs in one app.
description: Product × equipment cleaning validation matrix with HBEL (PDE) and 10 ppm MACO and swab/rinse limits, worst-case grouping and bracketing, validation runs with automatic failure, QA approval, revalidation and hold-time control, plus a new-product introduction impact check. Works in canvas, model-driven and Power Pages.
features: HBEL/PDE and ppm MACO with governing next product
Swab and rinse limits with recovery correction
Risk-scored worst-case grouping and bracketing rules
Run recording with automatic Failed status
react: 16.14.0 bundled (no platform library, no Fluent UI)
controlType: standard (2 controls: niray_Niray.CleaningValidationMatrix data-set + niray_Niray.CleaningValidationMatrixPortal field control for Power Pages, shared src/app)
